title: Sineng Electric launches 510 kW high-power string inverter for utility-scale solar
content:
Sineng Electric’s SP-510K-H is a 510 kW high-power string inverter for utility-scale solar projects, featuring 1,650 V DC input, 1,000 V AC output, six MPPTs, and support for DC/AC ratios up to 1.8. title: Renewables met 68% of Brazil’s electricity demand during FIFA World Cup
content:

Advance planning and enhanced grid monitoring enabled the operator to manage rapid load increases of up to 12.8 GW following matches.
